# Apache Avro interoperability fixtures

`weather*.avro` and `weather.json` are copied unmodified from `share/test/data` of
[apache/avro](https://github.com/apache/avro) at commit
`3a207fa6e87c535b95eafca4cf5a6ef524d77df2`. They are the shared interop files that
the Apache Avro language implementations read in their own tests.

They are licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`); `NOTICE` carries the
Apache Avro notice that applies to them.
